description:
Sparkledog , colloquially known as sparklefur , sparklecat , or sparkleanimal , is a genre of character design that primarily focuses on feral animal characters with oversaturated and unnatural colors, often multiple, as well as accessories and complex markings.

Initially, the term "sparkledog" was utilized as a derogatory term to refer to young artists' tendency to make brightly colored, often clashing or gaudy-looking, canid characters, particularly on platforms like DeviantArt. Over time, especially at the end of the 2010s, the concept has broadened, and the term has evolved into an affectionate term and is used by anybody with an interest in these types of characters. The elements of the sparklefur overlap with Scene , Furry , and Emo .
